channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Bills Execute the Most Insane Tush Push in NFL Playoff History
item.description: Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills executed an unbelievable tush push in the AFC Wild Card, moving the ball from the 10-yard line to the 1 before scoring the game-winning touchdown on the next play.

item.title: Michigan Football Lands Backup Plan for Bryce Underwood in Transfer Portal
item.description: Michigan strengthens its quarterback depth by adding a multi-year FBS starter from the transfer portal.

item.title: 49ers TE George Kittle Suffers Devastating Injury vs. Eagles
item.description: San Francisco 49ers tight end George Kittle was ruled out with a devastating Achilles injury in the second quarter against the Eagles in the NFC Wild Card round.

item.title: A Message to Hockeytown: Sergei Fedorov Speaks Ahead of No. 91 Retirement
item.description: Sergei Fedorov shares a heartfelt letter to Hockeytown ahead of his No. 91 jersey retirement Monday night at Little Caesars Arena when the Red Wings host the Hurricanes.

item.title: Michigan Football Lands No. 1 Tight End in Transfer Portal
item.description: Michigan Football strengthens its offense by landing former Utah tight end JJ Buchanan from the transfer portal, adding a proven young weapon for the 2026 season.

item.title: Detroit Lions Unlikely To Land Mike McDaniel For OC Position
item.description: The Detroit Lions are expected to interview former Dolphins head coach Mike McDaniel for their OC job, but multiple head coaching interviews make it unlikely he ends up in Detroit.

item.title: Aidan Hutchinson Explains What Really Cost Detroit a Playoff Spot
item.description: Detroit Lions star Aidan Hutchinson explains what went wrong in 2025 and says one key factor — a healthy secondary — can help the team bounce back in 2026.

item.title: Why the Detroit Lions Haven’t Re-Signed Jake Bates
item.description: According to Erik Schlitt of Pride of Detroit, the Lions have not yet re-signed Jake Bates because they may be working toward a longer-term contract instead of using the ERFA tender.

item.title: One Free Agent the Detroit Lions Could Sign to Replace David Montgomery
item.description: If the Detroit Lions move on from David Montgomery, Tyler Allgeier could be the perfect power back to pair with Jahmyr Gibbs in the 2026 season.

item.title: Big Opportunity Emerges for Detroit Lions DC Kelvin Sheppard
item.description: An emerging Detroit Lions coach is gaining league-wide attention and has been requested for an interview for a prominent NFL head coaching vacancy.
